Container.Name: shin-wallslice
Container.Overview: One wallpaper. Every device. Crop locally to six device presets, adjust framing and OLED shadows, then download PNGs or a ZIP. Optional AI is disabled by default. Single-user trusted-LAN access; no built-in login. Allow 4 GiB RAM and 4 GiB writable temporary disk space. Preferences persist in appdata; temporary jobs expire. Optional server saving (v1.2.0+) retains PNGs in a configured output directory; see the setup guide. Startup initializes only /data and preferences.json, then Fastify runs as UID/GID 1000.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Dedicated preferences and optional output directory. Do not map a share root here.

Config.Name: Advanced: enable AI
Config.Description: Optional. Requires your vision service URL and model.

Config.Name: Advanced: AI API base URL
Config.Description: Optional. Your vision service API URL ending in /v1. Leave blank when AI is disabled or configured through JSON. Requires image 1.0.1 or later.

Config.Name: Advanced: AI model
Config.Description: Optional. Your service's vision model identifier. Set a URL and model before enabling AI, or configure both through JSON.

Config.Name: Advanced: AI token
Config.Description: Optional bearer token. Leave blank for an unauthenticated local service. Blank clears any JSON token. Protect saved templates and flash backups.
